description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wurmcoil Engine, adding {C}{C}.
When Wurmcoil Engine dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Wurmcoil Engine triggers, creating a 3/3 Wurm token with deathtouch and a 3/3 Wurm token with lifelink.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Wurm token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Wurmcoil Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
